= Source-block Callouts

== Listing with callouts

[source,rust]
----
fn main() {
    let greeting = "hello"; <1>
    println!("{greeting}, world!"); <2> <3>
}
----
<1> Bind a string slice to a local.
<2> Format and print using an inline expression.
<3> Two callouts can share a single line.

== Plain listing with callouts

----
echo one  <1>
echo two  <2>
----
<1> First step.
<2> Second step.

== Listing without a colist

The markers still render even when no description list follows.

----
let x = 1; <1>
----

== Literal block with callouts

....
column one  <1>
column two  <2>
....
<1> Left side.
<2> Right side.
